description: Dried herrings, anchovies, sardines, sardinella, brisling or sprats, mackerel (incl Indian, jack, or horse), seerfishes, jacks, crevalles, cobia, silver pomfrets, Pacific saury, scads, capelin, swordfish, Kawakawa, bonitos, marlins, sailfishes, spearfish
Fish: salted or in brine, not dried or smoked, other than edible fish offal, cod (Gadus morhua, Gadus ogac, Gadus macrocephalus)
Birds' eggs, in shell: fresh, not for incubation, other than fowls of the species Gallus domesticus (domestic hens)
Flour, meal and powder: of the products of chapter 8
Bran, sharps and other residues: of leguminous plants, whether or not in the form of pellets, derived from the sifting, milling or other workings thereof

Wood: coniferous species n.e.c in headings 4403.22 or 4403.24, in the rough, whether or not stripped of bark or sapwood, or roughly squared, untreated, of which any cross-sectional dimension is less than 15 cm

Wood, tropical: as specified in Subheading Note 2 to this Chapter, dark red meranti, light red meranti and meranti bakau, in the rough, whether or not stripped of bark or sapwood, or roughly squared, untreated
Wood, tropical: sapelli, sawn or chipped lengthwise, sliced or peeled, whether or not planed, sanded or end-jointed, thicker than 6mm
Wood, tropical: iroko, sawn or chipped lengthwise, sliced or peeled, whether or not planed, sanded or end-jointed, thicker than 6mm
Silk: woven fabrics n.e.c. in heading no. 5007
Fabrics, woven: containing 85% or more by weight of cotton, of yarns of different colours, of weaves n.e.c. in item no. 5208.4, weighing not more than 200g/m2
Jute and other textile bast fibres: raw or retted, but not spun, (excluding flax, hemp (cannabis sativa L.), and ramie)
Fabrics, woven: containing 85% or more by weight of filaments of nylon or other polyamides, of yarns of different colours
Fabrics, woven: containing 85% or more by weight of synthetic filaments (excluding nylon or other polyamides and polyesters), unbleached or bleached
Fabrics, woven: of synthetic filament yarn, containing less than 85% by weight of synthetic filaments, printed
Fabrics, woven: of synthetic filament yarn, dyed, n.e.c. in heading 5407
Fabrics, woven: of synthetic staple fibres, containing 85% or more by weight of such fibres n.e.c. in heading no. 5512, other than unbleached or bleached
Fabrics, woven: unbleached or bleached, containing less than 85% by weight of synthetic staple fibres n.e.c. in item no. 55.14.1, mixed mainly or solely with cotton, exceeding 170g/m2
Fabrics, woven: of synthetic staple fibres n.e.c. in chapter 55, mixed mainly or solely with fibres n.e.c. in heading no. 5515
Fabrics, woven: of yarns of different colours, containing less than 85% by weight of artificial staple fibres, mixed mainly or solely with man-made filaments
Textile wicks, woven, plaited or knitted: for lamps, stoves, lighters, candles or the like: incandescent gas mantles and tubular knitted gas mantle fabric therefor, whether or not impregnated
Swimwear: men's or boys', of textile materials (other than synthetic fibres), knitted or crocheted
Diamonds: whether or not worked, but not mounted or set, unsorted
Iron or non-alloy steel: primary forms (excluding ingots and iron of heading no. 7203)
Machine-tools: for working wood, cork, bone, hard rubber, hard plastics or similar hard materials: grinding, sanding or polishing machines
Tools: for working in the hand, pneumatic, rotary type (including combined rotary-percussion)
